chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from a number of our companions from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr said:

I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the Umrah, is it obligatory? He said, 'Yes.' I said, 'Does one who performs Tamattu' have it count for him?' He said, 'Yes.' And it is recommended that a person performs Umrah once every month. He narrated.

key_terms.تَمَتَّعَ: Performed Tamattu' (a type of Hajj combining Umrah and Hajj)

ai.seo_question: Is Umrah obligatory and can it be performed monthly?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Rida (AS), the obligation of Umrah is confirmed, with a specific clarification that the Umrah component of Tamattu' Hajj suffices for the general Umrah duty, reflecting the jurisprudential principle of combining obligations. Furthermore, the recommendation to perform Umrah monthly highlights the Shia emphasis on frequent pilgrimage as a means of spiritual renewal and devotion. This view is supported by the broader tradition of the Ahl al-Bayt, which often elevates Umrah to a status comparable to Jihad in terms of reward.
